en.io: Takes an existing artifact along with a chosen theme name or custom visual description as input, and outputs the artifact styled with matching colors and fonts.
en.boundary: This skill only manages visual styling through fonts and hex color application, and does not generate or edit the underlying content of the artifact.
scenarios: Styling presentation slide decks or reports using pre-set professional themes
Displaying theme choices via a showcase PDF to gather user preferences
Generating a custom color and font theme on-the-fly based on specific user requirements

zh.io: 输入为待样式的产出物以及选定的主题名称或自定义描述，输出应用了相应字体和配色方案的产出物。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 仅负责配色和字体样式的选择与应用，不承担产出物具体内容的生成或撰写。
scenarios: 使用预设的专业主题对演示文稿或报告进行美化与样式统一
通过展示 PDF 文件向用户呈现多种主题样式并获取选择确认
根据用户的具体描述即时生成自定义的配色与字体组合主题
